A: Summary CSV sets negative and positive counts to zero, contradicting c1; these are not zero in the source.

The report says the cutoff is 144 days before October 23, though the stated exclusive cutoff is June 1 and the measured series ends May 31.

raw.verdict: C is the most decision-ready: it quantifies the shared April 2025 spike, ranks the three terms on a common window, and provides reproducible calls and useful caveats. Its selected-month chart/export and unresolved trend-label tension keep the timing evidence from being fully audit-ready; A has the complete chart but its export contradicts the recorded tone counts.
